ambient_events: Water goes along a row, slowly, from a can with a rose on it.
A ridge light is opened another two inches and propped.
Something is tied back with a strip of rag, gently, twice.
description: A long glazed vault on a low stone knee-wall, its ridge lights cracked open a hand's width. Inside, in rows, things are growing that nobody out here has bothered to grow in thirty years.
name: The Glasshouse
